# Ezra Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 470r–470v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_008_page_001.jpg

---

**8:1** And-these [are] the-heads of-their-fathers [rashei avoteihem] and-the-genealogy [ha-hityaches] of-those going-up with-me in-the-reign of-Artachshasta the-king from-Bavel:

**8:2** From-the-sons of-Pinechas — Gershom. From-the-sons of-Itamar — Dani'el. From-the-sons of-David — Chattush.

**8:3** From-the-sons of-Shekhanyah, from-the-sons of-Par'osh — Zekharyah, and-with-him enrolled-by-genealogy [hityaches] — males [zekharim] one-hundred fifty.

**8:4** From-the-sons of-Pachat-Mo'av — Elyeho'einai son of-Zerachyah, and-with-him two-hundred males.

**8:5** From-the-sons of-Shekhanyah — son of-Yachazi'el, and-with-him three-hundred males.

**8:6** And-from-the-sons of-Adin — Eved son of-Yonatan, and-with-him fifty males.

**8:7** And-from-the-sons of-Elam — Yesha'yah son of-Atalyah, and-with-him seventy males.

**8:8** And-from-the-sons of-Shephatyah — Zevadyah son of-Mikha'el, and-with-him eighty males.

**8:9** From-the-sons of-Yo'av — Ovadyah son of-Yechi'el, and-with-him two-hundred eighteen males.

**8:10** And-from-the-sons of-Shelomit — son of-Yosiphyah, and-with-him one-hundred sixty males.

**8:11** And-from-the-sons of-Bevai — Zekharyah son of-Bevai, and-with-him twenty-eight males.

**8:12** And-from-the-sons of-Azgad — Yochanan son of-ha-Qatan, and-with-him one-hundred ten males.

**8:13** And-from-the-sons of-Adoniqam — the-last-ones [acheronim], and-these their-names: Eliphelet, Ye'i'el, and-Shemayah, and-with-them sixty males.

**8:14** And-from-the-sons of-Bigvai — Utai and-Zabbud, and-with-them seventy males.

**8:15** And-I-gathered-them [va-eqbetsem] to the-river [ha-nahar] the-one-coming to-Ahava, and-we-encamped [va-nachaneh] there three days; and-I-looked-carefully [va-avinah] among-the-people and-among-the-priests, and-from-the-sons of-Levi I-did-not-find [lo matsati] there.

**8:16** And-I-sent for-Eli'ezer, for-Ari'el, for-Shemayah, and-for-Elnatan, and-for-Yariv, and-for-Elnatan, and-for-Natan, and-for-Zekharyah, and-for-Meshullam — heads [rashim]; and-for-Yoyariv and-for-Elnatan — men-of-understanding [mevinim].

**8:17** And-I-commanded [va-atsavveh] them concerning Iddo the-head [ha-rosh] at-the-place [ba-maqom] Kasiphya, and-I-put [va-asimah] in-their-mouth words to-speak to-Iddo and-his-brothers the-temple-servants [ha-netinim] at-the-place Kasiphya, to-bring to-us servants [mesharetim] for-the-house of-our-God.

**8:18** And-they-brought to-us, according-to-the-hand of-our-God the-good [ha-tovah] upon-us, a-man of-understanding [ish sekhel] from-the-sons of-Machli son of-Levi son of-Yisra'el, namely-Sherevyah, and-his-sons and-his-brothers — eighteen;

**8:19** and-Chashavyah, and-with-him Yesha'yah of-the-sons of-Merari, his-brothers and-their-sons — twenty;

**8:20** and-from-the-temple-servants [ha-netinim] whom David and-the-princes [ha-sarim] had-given for-the-service of-the-Levites — temple-servants two-hundred twenty; all-of-them designated [niqqevu] by-names [be-shemot].

**8:21** And-I-proclaimed there a-fast [tsom] at the-river Ahava, to-humble-ourselves [lehit'annot] before our-God, to-seek [levaqesh] from-him a-straight way [derekh yesharah] for-us and-for-our-little-ones [tappeinu] and-for-all our-possessions [rekhusheinu].

**8:22** For I-was-ashamed [boshti] to-ask from-the-king a-force [chayil] of-soldiers [parishim] and-horsemen to-help-us [le'ozreinu] against the-enemy [oyev] on-the-way [ba-derekh], for we-had-said to-the-king, saying, "The-hand of-our-God [is] upon all who-seek-him [mevaqqeshav] for-good [le-tovah], and-his-power [uzzo] and-his-wrath [ve-appo] [are] upon all who-forsake-him [ozvav]."

**8:23** So-we-fasted [va-natsumah] and-we-sought [va-nevaqshah] from-our-God concerning this, and-he-was-entreated [vaye'ater] by-us.

**8:24** And-I-set-apart [va-avdilah] twelve of-the-chiefs [sarei] of-the-priests — Sherevyah, Chashavyah, and-with-them ten of-their-brothers —

**8:25** and-I-weighed-out [va-eshqolah] to-them the-silver and-the-gold and-the-vessels, the-contribution [terumat] of-the-house of-our-God which the-king and-his-counselors and-his-princes and-all Yisra'el present [ha-nimtsa'im] had-contributed [herimu].

**8:26** And-I-weighed into-their-hand: silver — six-hundred fifty talents [kikkar]; and-vessels of-silver — one-hundred; talents of-gold — one-hundred;

**8:27** and-bowls [keforei] of-gold — twenty, of-a-thousand darics [adarkonim]; and-vessels of-fine-gleaming [tsehovar] bronze [nechoshet], precious [chamudot] like-gold.

**8:28** And-I-said to-them, "You [are] holy [qodesh] to-YHWH, and-the-vessels [are] holy, and-the-silver and-the-gold [are] a-freewill-offering [nedavah] to-YHWH the-God of-your-fathers.

**8:29** Watch [shiqqdu] and-keep [ve-shimru] them until you-weigh [tishqelu] them before the-chiefs of-the-priests and-the-Levites and-the-heads of-the-fathers of-Yisra'el in-Yerushalayim, in-the-chambers [lishkhot] of-the-house of-YHWH."

**8:30** And-the-priests and-the-Levites received [qibbelu] the-weight [mishqal] of-the-silver and-the-gold and-the-vessels, to-bring to-Yerushalayim to-the-house of-our-God.

**8:31** And-we-set-out [va-nissa'ah] from-the-river Ahava on-the-twelfth of-the-month the-first to-go to-Yerushalayim, and-the-hand of-our-God was upon-us, and-he-delivered-us [vayattsileinu] from-the-palm [mi-kaph] of-the-enemy [oyev] and-the-one-lying-in-wait [ve-orev] on-the-way.

**8:32** And-we-came to-Yerushalayim and-we-sat [va-neshev] there three days.

**8:33** And-on-the-day the-fourth was-weighed [nishqal] the-silver and-the-gold and-the-vessels in-the-house of-our-God, into the-hand of-Meremot son of-Uriyah the-priest, and-with-him El'azar son of-Pinechas, and-with-them Yozavad son of-Yeshua and-No'adyah son of-Binnui, the-Levites —

**8:34** by-number [be-mispar] by-weight [u-ve-mishqal] for-all, and-all the-weight was-written [va-yikkatev] at-that-time.

**8:35** The-ones-coming from-the-captivity [ha-shevi], the-sons of-the-exile [benei ha-golah], offered [hiqrivu] burnt-offerings [olot] to-the-God of-Yisra'el: bulls [parim] — twelve for all Yisra'el; rams [eilim] — ninety-six; lambs [kevasim] — seventy-seven; male-goats [tsefirei chattat] — twelve — all [as] a-burnt-offering to-YHWH.

**8:36** And-they-delivered [vayitnu] the-edicts [dattei] of-the-king to-the-satraps [achashdarpanei] of-the-king and-the-governors [pachot] of-the-region-Beyond-the-River, and-they-supported [ve-nisse'u] the-people and-the-house of-God.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.15 — "I did not find sons of Levi":** The alarming absence of Levites from the returning group reflects a persistent crisis — Levites were reluctant to return (cf. 2:40, only 74 Levites). Ezra must recruit them specifically, sending nine leaders and two "men of understanding" (*mevinim*) to the settlement at Kasiphya.

**v.21-23 — The fast at Ahava:** Ezra's refusal to ask for a military escort is theologically driven but practically risky. His own words to the king — "the hand of our God is on all who seek him" — have painted him into a corner. The Hebrew *boshti* ("I was ashamed") reveals the tension between faith and political reality.

**v.27 — "fine gleaming bronze":** The hapax legomenon *tsehovar* (rendered "gleaming" or "polished") is uncertain. It may describe a type of fine bronze alloy or a surface treatment that gave the metal a gold-like sheen.

*— EMET*
